div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Views room photos and
descriptions; books a room
type or a specific room on
web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Room photos and descriptions,
availability; books a room
type or a specific room;
sends the guest to the
payment operator's page.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Ordered room list with guest
wishes and defects; works
offline, sends updates when
Wi-Fi is back.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frame Rezerwacja + room
availability and status: the
only place that can take a
room for a night (one
transaction); holds the room
10 min while the guest
pre-authorises the payment at
the payment operator,
confirmed by webhook; never
waits for legacy; computes
when every hotel room is
needed next.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frames Housekeeping +
Servis tech: one queue for
cleaning and repairs,
priority from when the room
is needed next; API for cart
devices. Keeps its own copy
of room status and room
needed-by (events from
Rezerwacje), so it works on
the last known state while
Rezerwacje is down.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Board frame Synchronizacja:
the only place that swaps
files with legacy, both ways
every 15 min. In: room pool
we may sell, prices, non-pool
bookings, check-ins and
check-outs. Out: our pool
bookings with guest data,
check-ins / outs, payment
pre-authorisation number.
Numbered files, idempotent
import, alert on a missing
file; nightly full comparison
(pool: we win, non-pool:
legacy wins).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Managed PostgreSQL, one
schema per service; each
service has its own DB user
with access to its own schema
only; replica in a second
zone with automatic failover
in 1-2 min; nightly backup +
continuous log (point-in-time
restore, 7 days).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Existing system: non-pool
reservations, prices, stay
settlement and refunds at
checkout, cancellations,
manager reports. No API, only
file exchange. Blocks a room
pool that only we sell.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
External payment operator:
hosted payment page, card
pre-authorisation at booking.
We never see card data.
